correctness.rationale: For all integers n≥3,a≥1,q≥3 the PCF condition on a core vertex is exactly a nonempty singleton among two core-neighbor colors plus a pendant colors. The EGF r and s subtract all configurations with no singleton and exhaust equality/distinctness of the two core-neighbor colors. Because leaf sets are disjoint, summing over proper core colorings is trace(T^n) of the explicitly defined pair-state transfer. The invariant splitting into constants, standard x_u/x_v modes, symmetric zero-margin and antisymmetric zero-margin modes has dimensions 1,2(q−1),q(q−3)/2,(q−1)(q−2)/2, totaling q(q−1), with eigenvalues as in RESULT.md. Their n-th-power sum gives the claimed recurrence formula. At q=3 direct binarity proves r=a,s=2 and the a=2 uniformity. Separate local, explicit-transfer, core-word and full-coloring brute-force computations all reproduce the values with exact integers; the general proof is not inferred from finite checks.

originality.rationale: Relevant new and classical primary full texts were inspected, including the older general corona chromatic-number statement. That prior numerical result is specifically excluded from the asserted novelty. The reviewed claim is an all-q exact coloring count for an infinite two-parameter family with a constant-dimensional spectral description and a uniform-extension phenomenon. Broad choosability bounds, crown-graph counts, unrelated sunlet domination and generic ordinary chromatic polynomials do not imply this law; targeted published searches and published research-record search did not locate an equivalent. Unindexed literature or unpublished overlapping work remain real risks.
residual_risks: An older or unindexed result could count PCF colorings on generalized sunlets under an alternate graph-family name or as a specialization of a general transfer theorem.
Public-record search cannot reveal unpublished work and does not certify absolute originality.

value.rationale: The exact q-palette counting polynomial is a natural enumerative refinement of active open-neighborhood proper conflict-free coloring and of the existing corona chromatic-number theorem, not just a recomputation of the number of needed colors. The proof reveals a uniform four-spectral-family trace reduction for graphs with unbounded order and pendant multiplicity, permitting recurrence evaluation without enumerating colored vertex assignments. The special two-pendant, three-color identity identifies an exact cancellation of core-color pattern dependence (two local extensions per cluster, for every core coloring) that is invisible from chromatic-number statements. These are structural, all-parameter consequences rather than isolated small-n tables; the scope remains explicitly restricted to uniform hairy cycles.
